name: VGGSound: Large-Scale Audio-Visual Video Dataset
description: VGGSound is a large-scale audio-visual dataset comprising over 200,000 video clips (199,467 clips in the official repository release, each 10 seconds long, totaling ~550 hours) across 310 diverse sound categories collected from YouTube. Curated using automated visual and audio verification pipelines followed by human validation to ensure audio-visual correspondence (where the audio source is visually manifested within the video frame). Categories span human actions, animal vocalizations, musical instruments, vehicles, home appliances, and environmental sounds.

publisher.name: Visual Geometry Group (VGG), University of Oxford

verification.notes: Verified 199,467 video clips (183,971 train, 15,496 test) across 310 sound classes in the official repository release CSV (hche11/VGGSound), ICASSP 2020 paper, and CC BY 4.0 metadata terms. Access limitation: Oxford VGG website states download links are no longer available from the site; users must use annotation metadata to independently download video clips from YouTube subject to platform availability and Terms of Service. Third-party video copyrights belong to original uploaders.
